subject: Admin ledger handoff formats and UTC normalization for audit evidence
messages:
From: Eleni Parker <eleni.parker@greenlinehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity evidence for SOC2/SIG — scope + format questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for taking this. We're preparing our SIG questionnaire response and the SOC 2 review team wants a concrete sample of Redwood's admin activity evidence. Questions from the audit team: 

1) What specific admin events are captured (user creation, role change, console logins, API key ops, service-account actions, model rollout events)?
2) Retention windows by event class and whether we can request on-demand slices beyond the default retention.
3) Export delivery formats and transport (S3 presigned, SFTP, encrypted bundles, signed manifest).
4) Timestamp handling: are timestamps recorded in UTC and do exports include timezone normalization or original event timezone?
5) Chain-of-custody / manifest signing options (HMAC, signed manifest + checksum).

Can you send a short sample CSV of the event shape and note any PII redaction rules? We have a targeted evidence window for a customer-facing incident review (72-hour window) so timeline and turn-around matter.

Best,
Eleni Parker
Security Lead — Greenline Health

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Eleni Parker <eleni.parker@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC2/SIG — scope + format questions

Hi Eleni,

Appreciate the clear list — below is a concise rundown and I've attached a sanitized sample CSV (admin_activity_sample.csv) plus our handoff playbook (handoff-playbook-2029-03.pdf). High-level answers first, then specifics.

Quick answers:
- Captured events: yes to all you listed plus privilege elevation, API token rotation, and deployment rollbacks.
- Retention: default 365 days for admin-level events; can provide on-demand 2-year snapshots for audits under a supported SLA.
- Exports: parquet or CSV bundles delivered via S3 presigned URL or SFTP; bundles include signed manifest (SHA256) and optional HMAC signature.
- Timestamps: all internal storage is UTC; exports normalize to ISO8601 UTC by default. We also include original local tz offset as a separate field if requested.
- Chain-of-custody: export manifests include file checksums, an export_id, and a KMS-signed timestamp token on enterprise/private deployments.

Details and fields (from sample CSV):
- timestamp_utc (ISO8601)
- event_id (uuid)
- actor_email (redacted to role@ if PII removal requested)
- actor_id
- actor_role
- event_type
- resource_type
- resource_id
- region
- request_ip (partial redaction available)
- outcome (success/failure)
- request_payload_sha256 (pointer to hashed payload)
- kv_cache_hit (true/false)

PII / redaction notes:
- By default we retain actor_email; for HIPAA-sensitive customers we offer "role-only" redaction where actor_email is replaced with a role token (e.g., admin-ops@example-org). IPs can be truncated to /24 on export.

Turnaround and SLAs:
- On-demand 72-hour slices: 48–72 hours to produce a presigned S3 bundle (depends on window size).
- 2-year attested snapshot (for SOC2 evidence) requires a 7–10 business day lead time and involves a signed manifest and notarized checksum.

I'll leave in kimberly and karthik for the manifest signing and export transport details.

Thanks,
Neha
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eleni Parker <eleni.parker@greenlinehealth.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC2/SIG — scope + format questions

Hi Eleni / Neha,

A few implementation specifics from the export side:

1) Transport options:
  - S3 presigned URL: default for hosted customers. We upload bundle to a temporary bucket with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and hand over a presigned GET valid for a configurable window.
  - SFTP: supported for enterprise customers; bundle is encrypted with AES-256 and we provide SHA256 checksums in the manifest.
  - Direct streaming (rare) via secure transfer API — useful for very short windows or 3rd-party ingestion.

2) Manifest and signing:
  - Each bundle contains manifest.json (human-readable list of files + sha256) and manifest.sig (HMAC-SHA256).
  - For Private deployments we can produce an attestation token signed by our KMS key (x509 style timestamp). If you need a notarized attestation we can coordinate with our compliance team and supply chain partner.

3) Timestamp normalization:
  - Exports are normalized to UTC (timestamp_utc) and we include original_event_offset field if you want local tz for correlation. In addition, the manifest lists earliest_event_ts and latest_event_ts in UTC.

4) Validation steps you can run on receipt:
  - Verify SHA256 of each file against manifest.json.
  - Validate manifest.sig HMAC using the shared key we send over secure channel (or verify KMS-signed token metadata if Private).

5) PII-redaction toggle:
  - We provide query-time redaction APIs and export-time redaction. For exports, the redaction level is recorded in manifest.metadata.redaction_level (none/minimal/role-only/full).

If Greenline wants, we can run a short demo where we produce a 72-hour slice and walk your auditors through validation. Typical demo takes 30 minutes.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Eleni Parker <eleni.parker@greenlinehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, audit@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC2/SIG — scope + format questions

Thanks — that all looks helpful. A few follow-ups: 

- We will request a 72-hour slice first to validate tooling. Please schedule the demo next week (30 minutes) and prepare the bundle with role-only redaction and UTC-normalized timestamps.
- For the notarized attestation (2-year snapshot) we need to confirm whether Redwood will provide the KMS-signed token or if we should expect a vendor-signed notarization letter. Can Marissa help coordinate the attestation workflow and estimated legal lead time?

If you send calendar availability I will pick a slot. Also please include the HMAC verification key transfer mechanism in the demo (we prefer an out-of-band transfer to our KeyOps team).

Best,
Eleni
